// Stub for __NAME__. Run: pnpm skill __NAME__ --help
const skill = __NAME_LITERAL__;
const version = __VERSION_LITERAL__;
const abstract = __ABSTRACT_LITERAL__;
const commands = __COMMANDS_LITERAL__;

function help(): void {
  console.log(`${skill} ${version}`);
  console.log(abstract);
  console.log("");
  if (commands.length === 0) {
    console.log("No commands yet.");
  } else {
    console.log("Commands (stubs):");
    for (const command of commands) console.log(`  ${command}`);
  }
  console.log("");
  console.log(`Usage: pnpm skill ${skill} <command>`);
}

const [command, ...args] = process.argv.slice(2);

if (!command || command === "--help" || command === "-h") {
  help();
  process.exit(0);
}

if (command === "--version" || command === "-v") {
  console.log(version);
  process.exit(0);
}

if (!commands.includes(command)) {
  console.error(`Unknown command: ${command}`);
  console.error(`Available: ${commands.join(", ") || "none"}`);
  process.exit(2);
}

console.log(
  JSON.stringify({
    status: "stub",
    skill,
    command,
    args,
    message: "not implemented",
  }),
);
